<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" type="text/css">

<style>
.back-link { font-size: 0.9em; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.back-link a { color: #2980b9; text-decoration: none; }
.back-link a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.pub-page-header {
  margin: 28px 0 20px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
}
.pub-page-header h1 { font-size: 1.9em; font-weight: bold; color: #2c3e50; margin: 0; }
.pub-meta { font-size: 0.88em; color: #888; }
.pub-meta a { color: #2980b9; text-decoration: none; }
.pub-meta a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* ── Controls ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.pub-controls {
  display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.pub-search {
  flex: 1; min-width: 200px;
  padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #dde3ea;
  border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.92em; outline: none;
  background: #fff;
}
.pub-search:focus { border-color: #2980b9; }

.year-filters { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.yr-btn {
  padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid #dde3ea;
  border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.82em; font-weight: 600;
  background: #fff; cursor: pointer; color: #555;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.yr-btn:hover { background: #eef3f8; }
.yr-btn.active { background: #2980b9; color: #fff; border-color: #2980b9; }

/* ── Publication cards ────────────────────────────── */
.pub-year-heading {
  font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: 700; color: #2c3e50;
  margin: 32px 0 10px 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
.pub-year-heading hr { flex: 1; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e5e5e5; }

.pub-card {
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 18px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  transition: box-shadow .15s;
}
.pub-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

.pub-card-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; }

/* Journal badge */
.pub-journal-badge {
  flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 0.68em; font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px;
  white-space: nowrap; margin-top: 2px;
}
.jbadge-nature      { background: #fff0e0; color: #b85c00; border: 1px solid #f5d0a0; }
.jbadge-natcomms    { background: #e8f4fb; color: #1a6a9a; border: 1px solid #b3d9f0; }
.jbadge-sciadv      { background: #eaf6ea; color: #1e7e34; border: 1px solid #a8dba8; }
.jbadge-ecollett    { background: #f3eafc; color: #6b21a8; border: 1px solid #d8b4fe; }
.jbadge-geb         { background: #fff8e1; color: #92610a; border: 1px solid #f5e0a0; }
.jbadge-tree        { background: #fce8e8; color: #9b1c1c; border: 1px solid #f5b8b8; }
.jbadge-other       { background: #f1f3f5; color: #555;    border: 1px solid #dde3ea; }
.jbadge-preprint    { background: #f0f0f0; color: #888;    border: 1px solid #ddd; font-style: italic; }

.pub-title {
  font-size: 0.97em; font-weight: 600; color: #2c3e50; line-height: 1.4;
}
.pub-authors {
  font-size: 0.85em; color: #666; margin: 3px 0 0 0; line-height: 1.5;
}
.pub-authors strong { color: #2c3e50; }

/* Link buttons */
.pub-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
.pub-btn {
  font-size: 0.75em; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 5px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: opacity .15s;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
}
.pub-btn:hover { opacity: 0.78; text-decoration: none !important; }
.btn-pdf      { background: #2980b9; color: #fff !important; }
.btn-doi      { background: #27ae60; color: #fff !important; }
.btn-press    { background: #e67e22; color: #fff !important; }
.btn-supp     { background: #8e44ad; color: #fff !important; }
.btn-blog     { background: #7f8c8d; color: #fff !important; }
.btn-radio    { background: #c0392b; color: #fff !important; }

#pub-count { font-size: 0.85em; color: #888; margin-top: 4px; }
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  // Build year filter buttons
  var years = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".pub-year-block"))
    .map(function(b){ return b.dataset.year; });
  var filterDiv = document.getElementById("year-filters");
  var activeYear = "all";

  var allBtn = document.createElement("button");
  allBtn.className = "yr-btn active"; allBtn.textContent = "All";
  allBtn.onclick = function(){ setYear("all"); };
  filterDiv.appendChild(allBtn);

  years.forEach(function(y) {
    var btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "yr-btn"; btn.textContent = y; btn.dataset.year = y;
    btn.onclick = function(){ setYear(y); };
    filterDiv.appendChild(btn);
  });

  function setYear(y) {
    activeYear = y;
    document.querySelectorAll(".yr-btn").forEach(function(b){
      b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.year === y || (y === "all" && b.textContent === "All"));
    });
    applyFilters();
  }

  function applyFilters() {
    var q = document.getElementById("pub-search").value.toLowerCase();
    var total = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub-year-block").forEach(function(block) {
      var yearMatch = activeYear === "all" || block.dataset.year === activeYear;
      var cards = block.querySelectorAll(".pub-card");
      var visibleCards = 0;
      cards.forEach(function(card) {
        var text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
        var show = yearMatch && (q === "" || text.includes(q));
        card.style.display = show ? "" : "none";
        if (show) { visibleCards++; total++; }
      });
      block.style.display = visibleCards > 0 ? "" : "none";
    });
    document.getElementById("pub-count").textContent =
      total + " publication" + (total !== 1 ? "s" : "") + " shown";
  }

  window.filterPubs = applyFilters;
  applyFilters();
})();
</script>
